result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and signalized traffic control. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the environment lacks pedestrian buffers, street trees, and mid-crossing refuges, resulting in a long, exposed crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lane with no physical separation like trees or parked cars.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the brick building

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a central island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic and improve the walking environment.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but safety is compromised by significant physical obstructions. A utility pole and a parked van at the corner severely limit the effective sidewalk width and block sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located directly on the corner, significantly narrowing the pedestrian path and creating a physical barrier for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the corner of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A van is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of oncoming traffic for pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the foreground corner

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole away from the corner to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

result.summary: The street environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked asphalt roadway with a functional sidewalk present only on the right side. The absence of marked crossings, lane delineations, and a continuous pedestrian path on the left side creates a hazardous environment for people on foot, particularly given the mixed commercial and residential land use.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a formal paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk on an unpaved shoulder or in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks visible, making it unclear where pedestrians should cross safely and providing no designated right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire roadway width

hazards.name: Unmarked Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The absence of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable driver positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, separated walking path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental style) crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Paint lane lines to narrow the perceived travel path and install speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

result.summary: The environment features a wide sidewalk in the foreground that transitions into a narrow alleyway lacking dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. The alley serves as a shared space for vehicles and pedestrians without clear separation or traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The building on the left creates a sharp blind corner for vehicles exiting the alley onto the main sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground at the building corner

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large purple bin and other debris are placed at the entrance of the alley, narrowing the path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left at the alley entrance

hazards.name: Shared Vehicle/Pedestrian Space
hazards.description: The narrow alley lacks a protected walkway, forcing pedestrians to share the roadway with moving and parked vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Extending into the background along the alley

interventions.title: Convex Safety Mirror
interventions.description: Install a convex mirror at the alley exit to improve visibility between pedestrians on the sidewalk and exiting drivers.

interventions.title: Shared Street Markings
interventions.description: Implement 'Shared Street' or 'Woonerf' style pavement markings to signal to drivers that pedestrians have priority in the alley.

interventions.title: Waste Management Relocation
interventions.description: Designate a specific area for bins that does not obstruct the pedestrian entrance to the alley.
